status: registered; GPU implementation not admitted or run
hypothesis: Within-wheel command projection can accept more differential steering than the common-preserving scalar projection; the resulting common-mode change may either help or harm the complete task. Test both outcomes.
role: Bounded fixed-policy control-allocation intervention, not new PPO or established novel control theory
case_role: 136 existing development cases reused; no independent-test claim. Zero-leg seed labels are numerical/controller repeats, not independently trained zero policies.

definition.nominal: b=(diagnostic[4],diagnostic[5]), already feasible in original command_bounds
definition.filtered_request: r=(.3*memory[18],-.3*memory[18]) Nm, original public raw39 fixed assist and original slew/filter
definition.uniform_original: Original accepted commands and diagnostics unchanged; actual original global lambda used, not recomputed or replaced.
definition.component_wheels: u_i=clip(b_i+r_i,-B_i,+B_i), float32 command; accepted diagnostic wheel increment u_i-b_i in original float64 diagnostic semantics.
definition.timing: After original controller and leg room layer, before physics. Original hip commands, Nom calculation, targets/filter memory, Actor/Critic input dimension and physical limits unchanged.
definition.common_and_difference: m=(uL+uR)/2,d=(uL-uR)/2. With fractions alphaL/alphaR, Delta_m=(alphaL-alphaR)*steering/2 and Delta_d=(alphaL+alphaR)*steering/2; abs(Delta_m)<=.15 Nm for original request cap.
definition.important_tradeoff: More signed differential command in the same-state box does not prove more yaw acceleration or retained velocity/balance. If common command must stay fixed, scalar wheel lambda is maximal only along the original request segment alpha in[0,1].
definition.error_handling: Do not bypass original invalid flags or nonfinite/invalid map protections; component kernel must refuse invalid inputs rather than output unsafe commands.
definition.diagnostic_semantics: Update only wheel ctrl and accepted wheel diag[10:12]. Leave original lambda diag[12] as original global projection statistic; label it accordingly, not the new wheel acceptance factor. Original reward/physical/observation consumers must receive the new accepted wheel increments.

primary_gate.scope: Qualify whether this within-wheel allocation has development-task value, not the old learner-superiority gate
primary_gate.reference: Concurrent uniform zero-leg baseline plus preserved original B0/B1/B1-route successful cases from main development references
primary_gate.per_panel: Every numerical seed repeat is complete and physical/design clean, preserves all successful reference cases and original velocity/arrival/legacy roll-pitch nondegradation thresholds; paired Jpsi lower in at least2/3 repeats and panel mean reduction positive.
primary_gate.learned_increment: Separately report frozen learned-leg component versus zero-leg component for all3 seeds and bothpanels, including every lost/gained case. No learned utility claimed without all-seed success preservation and positive per-seed yaw reduction.
primary_gate.original_formal_learning_gate: Unchanged failed. Original 15% and0.05deg strong-reference yaw thresholds and all original criteria still govern future formal learned-method superiority.
primary_gate.negative: Close this component-allocation task-benefit route; no gain/weight/common-mode penalty sweep, budget extension or repeated fixed-policy rescue.
primary_gate.positive: Only a candidate nonlearning reference and possible coordination mechanism requiring independent qualification and matched future protocol; no old baseline replacement, learner promotion or automatic retraining.
primary_gate.unevaluated_original_requirements: Original28 regression and formal learned-superiority qualification remain required by the full original protocol but are not evaluated or claimed passed by this136-case development screen. No production/formal promotion without separately registered qualification.

limits: Current wheel-only diagnosis does not revive the rejected between-leg/wheel grouped mode; grouped_residual remains off.
Current policies were trained without fixed assist or component projection. This is a frozen-policy context intervention.
Command box feasibility is not future actual torque, working-domain invariance, contact or hardware safety.
Component clipping is an elementary projection, not standalone algorithm novelty. General saturation redistribution has established control-allocation prior art.
Do not change original task/reward formulas, request cap, thresholds, old CPU/GPU baseline or sealed final tests.
